title: NormalizedEvent
description: Forge-neutral routing input for fullsend dispatch and harness CEL trigger evaluation (ADR 0061). v1 targets GitHub Actions webhooks (including Discussions via entity.kind conversation and transition.comment id/parent_id per ADR 0086), GitLab cron-poll input (ADR 0067) and planned GitLab native-webhook input (ADR 0125), and Jira poll input (ADR 0063).

repo_path.description: Repository path (owner/repo for GitHub, group/subgroup/project for GitLab). Adapters MUST reject path segments containing '..' (path traversal) independently of this pattern.

kind.description: Forge-neutral entity kind (issue vs PR/MR vs conversation/Discussion/channel). Threads are not a separate entity.kind; reply association uses transition.comment.parent_id. See ADR 0086.

id.description: Stable numeric entity id in the source system (GitHub issue/PR number, Jira issue id).

key.description: Human-readable work item key when the source system uses one (e.g. Jira PROJ-123). Required when source.system is jira.

url.description: Canonical URL for the entity in its source system.

linked_change_proposal.description: When transition occurs on a work_item that is also a change proposal (e.g. GitHub PR comment events). When state.change_proposal is present, linked_change_proposal.id MUST equal state.change_proposal.id.

kind.description: Semantic lifecycle transition. Prefer edited/synchronized over updated; adapters MAY map reopened to opened when distinction is unnecessary.

id.description: Backend message id for this comment. Required when entity.kind is conversation on comment_* transitions (ADR 0086). GitHub: comment id or node_id; Slack: message ts.

parent_id.description: Thread-root message id — always the safe reply target for this comment's thread (ADR 0086). Required when entity.kind is conversation on comment_* transitions. Equal to comment.id for top-level / thread-root messages; for replies, the root id (normalize GitHub discussion_comment null parent to id; Slack thread_ts, or ts when the message starts the thread).

command.description: First whitespace-delimited token of the first line (e.g. /fs-triage).

body.description: Comment body truncated to 4096 Unicode code points for dispatch transport.

instruction.description: Text after the command, extracted from the raw comment before body truncation (e.g. /fs-fix instruction).

reviewer_id.description: Forge login of the reviewer (bot accounts end with [bot] on GitHub).

id.description: Forge login or service account identifier.

role.description: Effective repository permission level (ADR 0054). Adapters populate from the forge collaborator permission API when available.

is_entity_author.description: True when actor.id is the author of the work item, change proposal, or conversation.

labels.description: Snapshot of label names on the entity at event time. See state.conversation for conversation-specific label semantics.

id.description: Backend-stable category id when available (e.g. GitHub GraphQL node id).

name.description: Human-readable category name (GitHub Discussion category; Slack channel section when mapped).

slug.description: Backend slug when available. On GitHub, present in webhook REST payloads (discussion.category.slug) but not on GraphQL DiscussionCategory; GITHUB_EVENT_PATH adapters can populate it, GraphQL-only enrichment cannot. Treat as untrusted input even after schema validation — no structural pattern is enforced so Slack/Discord/Matrix adapters can pass through backend identifiers.

format.description: Optional portable category format for routing. Not a permission authority (ADR 0054). GitHub GraphQL DiscussionCategory exposes isAnswerable but no announcement/poll/discussion format field: adapters MUST set question_answer when isAnswerable is true, and SHOULD omit format otherwise unless they document an explicit heuristic (e.g. name/slug matching). UI-only GitHub create restrictions (e.g. announcement maintain/admin) are not queryable via the public API and MUST NOT be inferred solely from this field.

category.description: Exclusive category of the conversation (1:M category→conversation). Distinct from state.labels (M:M tags on the conversation, not on threads or messages).

conversation.description: Required when entity.kind is conversation and forbidden otherwise (ADR 0086). Snapshot of conversation metadata at event time. Threading is on transition.comment (id / parent_id), not here. state.labels are labels on the conversation; category is not a label; threads and messages are not labeled independently.

head_ref.description: Head branch name (Git ref) for checkout and push.

base_ref.description: Base branch name (Git ref) the change proposal targets.

head_sha.description: Commit SHA at the change-proposal head when known (optional; adapters should populate from webhooks when available).

paths.description: Changed file paths relative to the repository root. May be truncated when the forge caps the list; see paths_complete.

paths_complete.description: True only when paths is present and lists every changed file.

diff.description: Optional change facts at head_sha, added for ADR 0112's routing and not yet populated by any adapter. Untrusted (README, Trusted fields).

key.description: Human-readable key when the id alone is ambiguous, for example a Jira key (PROJ-123) or a cross-repository reference (owner/repo#12).

linked_work_items.description: Optional work items the change proposal links to (for example through closing keywords), added for ADR 0112's routing and not yet populated by any adapter. Untrusted: the author chooses which items are linked (README, Trusted fields).

change_proposal.description: Required when the matched harness needs change-proposal execution context (review, fix, retro on a PR). id MUST match entity.id or entity.linked_change_proposal.id when those are present. Adapters must populate branch and repo fields so dispatch can project event_payload without API round-trips.

system.description: Event provenance. v1 adapters emit github (webhooks), gitlab (cron-poll input per ADR 0067; planned native-webhook input per ADR 0125), jira (poll input), manual, or schedule.

raw_type.description: Native event or object type (e.g. issues, issue_comment for GitHub; issue, comment for Jira).

raw_action.description: Native action when applicable (e.g. created, labeled, synchronize).
